system.description:
He wants a world of silence. No life, only undead servitude.

  • Patron boon: You sense corpses, undead and the dying within 60ft, and learn a body's time of death by touch.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Orcus in the World of Arneyan wiki.
